text: タカと　いっしょに　まけちゃった…　えへへ

structure.jp: タカと　いっしょに

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the casual short form of てしまった, which says something happened completely, often to your regret. まけちゃった = 'I went and lost'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: タカと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: と with いっしょに says who you do something with. タカと　いっしょに = 'together with Jon'.
